name: A Boar's Delight
summary: Gobam asks you to gather sweet berries and river plants for Snufflesnout, Chub'chob's pet. The ingredients will make a special treat.

sections.title: A Pet's Treat
sections.body: Gobam wants to make something special for Snufflesnout, who loves good food. You are asked to bring back sweet berries and river plants for the treat.

faq.answer: Gobam is asking you to bring ingredients for a special treat for Snufflesnout, Chub'chob's pet.
Snufflesnout is Chub'chob's pet and loves good food.
Gobam asks for sweet berries and riverweed to make a treat for Snufflesnout.
Gobam wants sweet berries and riverweed to make a special treat for Snufflesnout.
